query: SELECT coalesce(sum(octet_length(before_state::text)::bigint + octet_length(after_state::text)),0)::bigint AS "bytes!" FROM metadata_undo_operations WHERE user_id = $1 AND session_id = $2 AND manifestation_id = $3 AND (($4::uuid IS NOT NULL AND request_id = $4) OR ($5::uuid IS NOT NULL AND id = $5)) AND expires_at > clock_timestamp()
